comments.author: Rufas
comments.body: There's an astro consumable called 'Special Hearty Meal' which has this effect upon use. In other words, instantly gives your pet max intimacy.

wiki:
UWC Item: Hearty Special Meal : able to obtain full intimacy +200 at a time.
